svg.title: The surprise of each of the specimen's 80 predictions, as it learns.
svg.desc: Each hairline is −log p(y) for one (context, next character) pair, over 200 steps of training (AdamW, η 0.02 → 0.002 (warmup 20, cosine), β₂ 0.95, weight decay 0.01 on matrices, clip 1); time runs left to right on a log(1 + step) scale, surprise upward on a square-root scale from 0 to 2.52 nats. The value-ink line is their mean, the loss, which ends at 0.0589 nats: the plateaux are contexts the text itself leaves ambiguous.
